content:
Great concept and very suitable for a clash. Here are my suggestions:
** STATEMENT **
- Please change all instances of [[S]] to [[s]] as that is how the stub-generator generates the variable in the IDE.
- Please remove the extra newline \n in the statement between { ↔ } and "All other characters remain unchanged.

** INPUT **
- Please change all instances of [[S]] to [[s]] just like the statement.

Output is good as is.

** CONSTRAINTS **
- Please change all instances of [[S]] to [[s]] just like the statement.
- Please change the upper boundary of your constraint to a lower value that matches your test cases. Currently, your longest string is 19 characters. My recommendation is to make the longest string 30 characters.

** TEST CASES **
If @5DN1L decides to review as well, he or she may have additional suggestions. But these are mine:
- Currently, none of your visible test cases uses the braces {}. I would add a new case with the braces in the that string.
Sample (you can use a different one): {}qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm{}
My sample also covers the 30 character boundary suggestion, so if you are looking for some ideas, I would use the sample. And for the corresponding validator, you can just delete like 2 characters from the sample and output its corresponding solution.

** STUB GENERATOR **
- Please get rid of read N:int in the stub-generator as it doesn't correspond to the input section and isn't needed to solve this clash.

Thank you!

@VINCE_MX, that's a good review. One small note: **CONSTANTS** / constant should be **CONSTRAINTS** / constraint 😉

Other points:

Constraints
* Please add "[[s]] contains" before the second constraint.

Stub generator
* Please update 1000 to match the same revised upper bound that will be used in the Constraints section.

Cases
* In addition to the new pair of cases covering the full lowercase alphabet as @VINCE_MX suggested, please add another pair of cases to cover the full uppercase alphabet.

* The different types of brackets should be covered in both the tests and the validators. The current coverage is insufficient.

Thanks.
Oops! Fixed the typo. Thank you for pointing out the other suggestions because I'm still pretty new to reviewing and don't know how to find them just yet.

Thanks for the review.

I will apply all requested changes:

replace all [[S]] with [[s]] in Statement, Input and Constraints
remove the extra newline in the Statement
set constraint upper bound to 30
add a visible test case using {} and update the corresponding validator
remove read N:int from the stub generator

Everything else remains unchanged as Output is already correct.

Thanks again.
